_comment: Egg SA-MP Windows via Wine para Pterodactyl. Mantem a base do servidor Windows e preserva arquivos de clientes.
name: SA-MP Windows via Wine
author: Loxy Hosting
description: SA-MP Windows em Pterodactyl via Wine, com plugins .dll, suporte opcional ao SampVoice e inicializacao segura em ambiente Linux do panel.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
cleanup() { rm -rf -- "${TMP_DIR}"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

log() { printf '[LOXY INSTALLER] %s\n' "$*"; }
fail() { printf '[ERRO] %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}" "${SERVER_DIR}/plugins" "${TMP_DIR}/extract"

log "Baixando servidor Windows do SA-MP..."
if ! curl -fLsS --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 10 \
    -o "${TMP_DIR}/samp.zip" "https://files.sa-mp.com/samp037_svr_R2-1-1_win32.zip"; then
  fail "Nao foi possivel baixar o pacote oficial do SA-MP Windows."
fi

[[ -s "${TMP_DIR}/samp.zip" ]] || fail "O pacote baixado do SA-MP esteve vazio."
unzip -o -q "${TMP_DIR}/samp.zip" -d "${TMP_DIR}/extract" || fail "O pacote baixado nao e um ZIP valido do SA-MP Windows."

if [[ -d "${TMP_DIR}/extract/server" ]]; then
  cp -a "${TMP_DIR}/extract/server/." "${SERVER_DIR}/"
else
  cp -a "${TMP_DIR}/extract/." "${SERVER_DIR}/"
fi

if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/samp-server.exe" ]]; then
  fail "samp-server.exe nao foi encontrado apos a extracao do pacote."
fi

if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg" ]]; then
  cat > "${SERVER_DIR}/server.cfg" <<'CFG'
port 7777
maxplayers 50
hostname Loxy Hosting SA-MP Windows
announce 1
query 1
lanmode 0
rcon 1
rcon_password changeme
plugins
CFG
fi

chmod 755 "${SERVER_DIR}/samp-server.exe" 2>/dev/null || true
find "${SERVER_DIR}/plugins" -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + 2>/dev/null || true
log "Instalacao do servidor Windows finalizada."
